text: This report provides the Toronto Investment Board (Board) with an update regarding activities involving investment managers and related parties. It includes changes to the investment manager mandates, contracts, and funding along with other related items. Further to the confidential information provided at the Board's last meeting with respect to the changes at CBRE Global Alpha Fund, Aon has provided a Flash Report from the Townsend Group (which is part of the Aon group of companies). The report is a summary of recent personnel changes at CBRE Investment Management with Townsend continuing to recommend the CBRE real estate funds as a "buy". This includes the CBRE Global Alpha Fund which has been contracted by the Board. Further details are listed in Attachment 1.
